title: customer-portal definition inputs
description: The closed input set of the customer-portal capability: an installation's own developer portal, released from the fleet's backstage bases into extras/backstage of its management-clusters repository, signing people in on the installation's Dex. The renderer turns these inputs into the portal's fileset — the two kustomizations, the app-config and values ConfigMaps, the Secrets the chart reads its credentials from, the plugin signing keys, the tunnel's SPIFFE bundle reference — and, on an installation without the agent platform, the portal's Dex client in the installation's dex-app configmap patch. A key an installation carries that no input renders and that removals.yaml does not list refuses the render, naming the key. Annotations: x-source says where a value comes from (registry: read from the installations registry, never typed; person: typed by the person enabling or reconciling; generated: created by the engine once and read back from the checkout afterwards). x-feature names the consistency feature of features.yaml the input's dimensions roll up to. x-renders lists the key paths the input produces, prefixed by the file: backstage:kustomization (extras/backstage/kustomization.yaml and extras/backstage/backstage/kustomization.yaml), backstage:app-config (the app-config ConfigMap's backstage.appConfig), backstage:user-values (the user-values ConfigMap), backstage:file (a file of the portal's directory), dex-configmap (the dex-app configmap patch). List indices are written [*], per-installation map keys <name>. A default is declared only where every portal agrees.

installation.description: Facts about the installation that are on record. Read from the installations registry; never typed.

name.description: The installation's codename: the portal's sign-in provider oidc-<name>, its Kubernetes cluster entry, its installation entry and the Dex client's environment variables AUTH_DEX_<NAME>_CLIENT_ID and _CLIENT_SECRET derive from it.

baseDomain.description: The installation's base domain; the Dex, API and reading hosts derive from it.

customer.description: The owning organisation as the management-clusters and configs repositories name it.

provider.description: The infrastructure provider, shown on the installation entry.

region.description: The installation's region, shown on the installation entry.

pipeline.description: The installation's release pipeline (stable, testing), shown on the installation entry.

agentPlatform.description: The agent-platform capability is enabled on this installation. Then the portal's extras/backstage/kustomization.yaml lists the agent-platform definition's Component (./agent-platform/), that definition owns the installation's dex-app configmap patch and carries the portal's Dex client in it, and this definition renders no dex patch.

portal.description: The portal as the person names it.

domain.description: The portal's hostname: its route, its base URLs, CORS origin and the Dex client's redirect URI.

organization.description: The organisation's name as the portal shows it.

supportUrl.description: Where the home page's support link goes: the customer's support channel.

telemetrydeckAppId.description: The TelemetryDeck app the portal reports usage to; the salt is generated. Without it, no telemetry block.

line.description: The semver range the portal's OCIRepository follows, patched over the fleet base's tag.

plugins.description: The portal's plugins beyond the always-on techdocs, kubernetes, permission and catalog.

github.description: The GitHub integration through a GitHub App. Its client id, client secret, private key and webhook secret are supplied at commit (plugins.github.clientId, clientSecret, privateKey, webhookSecret) and land in the Secret github-app-credentials-backstage, which the chart writes into github-app-credentials.yaml.

enabled.description: Render the integration, its Secret and the Secret's values source.

appId.description: The GitHub App's id — an identifier, not a credential.

domain.description: The Grafana instance the plugin links to.

gitRepositoryPatterns.description: How a GitRepository's URL maps to a browsable file URL, for hosts the plugin does not know.

targetUrl.description: The file URL template over the pattern's named groups.

gitRepositoryUrlPattern.description: The regular expression with named groups the repository URL matches.

sentry.description: Error reporting to Sentry. The DSNs of the app and the backend and the CSP report URI are supplied at commit (plugins.sentry.appDsn, backendDsn, reportUri) and land in user-secrets-backstage.

enabled.description: Render the error reporters, the CSP report URI and the Secret's sentry values.

tunnel.description: The tunnel to another installation's agent platform through tunnelport.

enabled.description: Render the tunnel's SPIFFE trust bundle reference: the ExternalSecret that copies the bundle from the platform namespace into the portal's, with its store and reader.

pluginKeys.description: The portal's generated credentials: the plugin-to-plugin signing key pair (Secret plugin-keys-backstage, mounted by the chart under /app/plugin-keys/<keyId>/ and read by backend.auth.pluginKeyStore), the session secret and the Dex client secret (Secret user-secrets-backstage; the client secret is the same value as in the Dex client's Secret dex-client-backstage) and the telemetry salt. The engine creates them once and reads them back from the checkout afterwards; no person value.

keyId.description: The signing key pair's id, the directory the chart mounts it under.
